# MauTravel — Airport Transfer & Taxi Service in Mauritius

MauTravel is a licensed private taxi and airport transfer company based in Mauritius. We specialise in fixed-price transfers from Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam (SSR) International Airport to any hotel, villa, or resort on the island, as well as private day tours, full-day hire, hotel transfers, and group travel.

## Contact

- WhatsApp / Phone: +230 58269725
- Email: mautravel.taxi@gmail.com
- Available: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Booking: Via WhatsApp at https://wa.me/23058269725

## Services

- **Airport Transfers** — Meet-and-greet pickup from SSR Airport with flight tracking and direct drop-off to any accommodation. Fixed prices, no hidden charges.
- **Hotel Transfers** — Resort-to-resort and villa transfers across Mauritius.
- **Full-Day Private Taxi** — Flexible day hire with customisable stops and relaxed island pacing.
- **Car Rental Assistance** — Rental support for independent travellers.
- **Group Travel** — Vans and minibuses for families, wedding guests, and cruise visitors.
- **Custom Private Tours** — Fully personalised routes: beaches, viewpoints, waterfalls, cultural sites.

## Private Day Tours

- **South Mauritius Tour** (EUR 145) — Chamarel Seven Colored Earth, Chamarel Waterfall, Trou aux Cerfs volcanic crater, tea route.
- **North Mauritius Tour** (EUR 95) — Grand Baie, Cap Malheureux, beaches, craft markets.
- **East Coast Adventure** (EUR 210) — Île aux Cerfs island, parasailing, snorkeling, speedboat, beach lunch.
- **West Coast Tour** (EUR 135) — Flic en Flac, Tamarin, Black River, Le Morne, sunset views.
- **Family Adventure** (EUR 160) — Kid-friendly parks, Pamplemousses Botanical Garden, child seats available.
- **Casela Nature Parks** (EUR 150) — Safari-style encounters, ziplines, mountain scenery.
- **Sunset Tour** — Dolphin watching, Flic en Flac beach, west coast sunset.
- **Vallée de Ferney** — East coast nature reserve, deer, endemic birds.

## Key Locations Served

Grand Baie, Port Louis, Flic en Flac, Le Morne, Chamarel, Île aux Cerfs, Casela, Trou aux Biches, Belle Mare, Blue Bay.

## Pricing

Prices range from EUR 30 (short hotel transfer) to EUR 210 (full-day east coast tour with island boat). Payments accepted in EUR, USD, and MUR. No prepayment required. Free cancellation.

## About

MauTravel has been operating for over 10 years with more than 850 tours completed and 1,800+ airport transfers. Rated 5.0 stars by 205+ verified guests. All drivers are licensed, English-speaking, and experienced with tourist routes across the island.
